architectural_fidelity.reason: The window has been completely redesigned with added mullions/grids that don't exist in the original, fundamentally altering the architectural character; the second window's light pattern is gone; the textured ceiling remains but the room feels compressed.

furniture_removal.reason: All original furniture including bed, nightstand, rug, and cat have been completely removed with no ghost traces or remnants visible.

style_commitment.reason: Strong Japandi execution: minimalist low platform bed, rice paper pendant lights, neutral natural palette, light wood flooring, subdued textile layers, and restrained aesthetic clearly committed to the style.

editorial_density.reason: Severely understaged with only a bed, two pillows, one small side table with vase, one thin rug, and pendant lights—lacks the layered textiles, wall art, plants, reading chair, additional lighting sources, and curated vignettes expected at AD level.

photorealism.reason: Natural lighting with accurate window shadows, realistic material textures on wood floor and textiles, proper ceiling texture preservation, and coherent light modeling throughout.

designer_preference_reason: Collov delivers fully realized, client-ready spaces with editorial styling density that justifies design fees, while Cova's architectural alterations and sparse staging would require significant explanation and additional work.
what_cova_does_better: Authentic Japandi minimalism with appropriate restraint
Superior ceiling fixture replacement with style-appropriate rice paper pendants
what_collov_does_better: Complete editorial styling with multiple textile layers, wall art, seating, and accessory vignettes
Preserves original window architecture without adding non-existent mullions
Client-ready presentation density suitable for portfolio or listing photos
Better architectural fidelity to existing conditions
specific_fixes_if_failing: CRITICAL: Preserve original window design—remove added mullions/grids that don't exist in the base architecture
Add editorial density: wall art (2-3 pieces), reading chair or bench, floor plant, additional table lamp, throw pillows (4-5), layered rug or larger statement rug
Include styled nightstand vignette: books, small plant, decorative objects
Add textile richness: throw blanket, additional cushions, consider textured headboard
